definitions.explanation: An attitude or stance that refuses to make concessions. Typically describes a negotiating position, political stance, or response that is forceful and unbending.

examples.japanese: {強硬|きょうこう}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さない→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: Maintain a hardline stance without wavering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強硬|きょうこう}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧{構|かま}えだ。
examples.english: The government is prepared to resort to forceful measures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労働組合|ろうどうくみあい}→労働組合：16096_roudoukumiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賃上|ちんあ}げ→賃上げ：14256_chinage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{強硬|きょうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: The labor union continued to negotiate firmly in demanding a pay raise.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in political and diplomatic reporting. Can be used as a na-adjective ({強硬|きょうこう}な〜) or as an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({強硬|きょうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). Also appears as the first element in compounds ({強硬|きょうこう}{派|は}, {強硬|きょうこう}⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強硬|きょうこう}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: hardline stance
- {強硬|きょうこう}{派|は}: hardliners, hawks
- {強硬|きょうこう}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: forceful measures
- {強硬|きょうこう}⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧: hardline policy
- {強硬|きょうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to firmly oppose
